verifier.evidence: HTTP 200. Plain 'Metacin Tablet', paracetamol 500mg. Metacin 650 is distinctly named and excluded.
verifier.notes: MEDIUM: entity granularity. Our record says 'Themis Medicare' (the listed company, per the earlier audit) while every pharmacy schema.org field reads 'Themis Pharmaceuticals Prop Chemosyn Ltd' - a related Themis marketing entity. Apollo also maintains a 'Themis Medicare Ltd' manufacturer page for these products. Same brand-owner family, so accepted, but the string is not identical. Metacin 650, Metacin Exs, and the syrup/suspension/drops/suppository/injection forms were rejected.
